Page 45 Cont.
Apr. 27 Octavia Morrin - 74 - hemoraging from head and stomach when enrolled last Friday. To astonishment of all concerned improving rapid.
28 Edna Masseau - 26 - nurse in T.B. San. (N. Villa) now threatened with T.B. of Spine. ... asks for prayers that she be resigned to God's holy will. Ellen Dawson - 66 - tuomer or inward cancer .... fears operation. En- rolled as perpet'l member To-day.
1938, May
Page 46
May 4 Alfred Rinklin - 19 - lutheran - Tumer on the brain - Enrolled April 23 in S. Mass Assoc'n - Father became Catholic some years ago but rather neglected practive .... Enrolls self last Tuesday promising to go back to Confession if boy is spared. To-day boys case more hope- ful - can see father going to confession to-night
Clifford Mayne - 37 - Harper Hos. - toxic poison of liver ... Dr. give him 4 months to live
Schmadt Family of Wyandote
George Neuman - 10 - unable to walk for two years. One of four liv- ing children, father not seen in six years ... Grandma enrolls Poor Souls Specially with found 10.00
Mrs. Emma McGuiness - 84 gradually becoming weaker - asks through daughter for prayers for grace of happy death
Helen Eliz. Hennan of Cleveland - 12 - fearful headaches lasting a whole week at a time. Cause unknown. Her brother too - 19 - has developed T.B.
Employment.
Page 47 May 8 E'd Nugent - 43 - looking for Employment has held good positions - been successful as insurence, etc but has lost out ... losing confi- dence in self ..... phone Univ. 2-1156
9 Joseph Nawrolnik - 64 - stomach cancer - can keep nothing on sto- mach ... now two years .... Enrolled.
